Thresholds and safety switches for the c: Thresholds and safety switches for the compression pipeline.
Reduce request size before routing while: Reduce request size before routing while preserving code, errors, paths, numbers, and tool definitions.
Rewrites each request before it is sent: Rewrites each request before it is sent to a provider so it uses fewer tokens. Code, errors, file paths and numbers are protected, and any rewrite that damages them is discarded.
Off sends requests untouched. Lossless o: Off sends requests untouched. Lossless only removes duplicated and wasted text. Standard also shortens tool output. Aggressive additionally condenses older turns.
Each engine is one rewriting step. The m: Each engine is one rewriting step. The mode decides which engines run; switching one off here keeps it out of every mode.
Replaces a block of text that already ap: Replaces a block of text that already appeared earlier in the conversation with a short reference to it.
Trims trailing spaces, collapses repeate: Trims trailing spaces, collapses repeated blank lines and drops duplicated system messages.
Replaces an earlier file read with a not: Replaces an earlier file read with a note once the same file is read or edited again later.
Shortens command and tool output such as: Shortens command and tool output such as builds, tests and installs. Error and stack-trace lines always survive.
Re-encodes long JSON arrays that share t: Re-encodes long JSON arrays that share the same fields as a compact table. Reversible, so nothing is lost.
Drops the sentences least related to the: Drops the sentences least related to the latest message once a message exceeds its size budget.
Condenses turns beyond the most recent f: Condenses turns beyond the most recent few into a short summary that keeps paths, errors and decisions.
Removes the least valuable lines until t: Removes the least valuable lines until the request fits the token target.
Requests estimated above this many token: Requests estimated above this many tokens switch to Aggressive automatically. Leave empty to disable.
Leaves a system prompt untouched once th: Leaves a system prompt untouched once the same text has been seen three times, so provider-side prompt caching keeps working.
Also loads tool-output filters from the: Also loads tool-output filters from the working directory. Off by default, because a repository could use it to hide output from the model.
Send a request body through the pipeline: Send a request body through the pipeline to see what a provider would receive.
